spelling_scope_quote: - **Spelling split** (new, from r1). Burkina_Faso and Senegal `plot_inputs` say `Maïs en grain` (2,274 / 735 rows) and `Niébé/Haricots secs` (2,156 / 460 rows), where their `crop_production` says `Maïs` and `Niébé`. Coverage including the marker is Burkina_Faso 5/9 and Senegal 6/10. A join of `seed_kg` onto `crop_production` on `j` silently misses maize and cowpea seed in those two countries. Fix it in the two countries' `harmonize_seed_crop` (or equivalent) mapping.
